# Card reference {#sec-cards}

All cards in the game, with the level at which each one is introduced.
Use the search box (top left) to find a card by name.

| Card                              | Cards Number      | Level(s) | Effect                                                                |
|-----------------------------------|-------------------|:--------:|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Inner/Outer Move Forward/Backward | 12 (12 types x1)  | 1        | Move a piece up to 3 squares in the inner/outer lane, forward/back    |
| Superposition                     | 5                 | 1        | Move into a superpisition of lanes                                    |
| Measurement                       | 5                 | 1        | Collapse into a single lane                                           |
| Inner/outer move                  | 12? (4 types x3)  | 1+? or 2+| Move forward/back in inner/outer lane - option based on die roll      |
| Lane change                     | 4?                | 2-3      | Change lanes                   |
| Colour change                       | 4?                | 2-3      | Change colour of counters          |
|Lane measurement                 | 5?                | 2-3      | Lane measurement / Colour superposition |
|Colour measurement                   | 5?                | 2-3      |Colour measurement / lane superposition |
|Entanglement + lane measurement    | 5?              | 3   | Entanglement and measurement in lane basis |
|Entanglement + colour measurement | 5?  |3| Entanglement and measurement in colour basis |
